hook: Heavy wooden doors creak open to reveal a chained prisoner being marched into a lavish wedding to be publicly humiliated.
cliffhanger: Juliana stands straight and defies Catherine, asking if she needed an entire chapel to feel powerful over one chained woman.
standalone_clarity: A new viewer can easily grasp the core conflict of a cruel ruling class publicly shaming a defiant captive woman, though exact backstory details are omitted.
narrative_context: Catherine stops her wedding to parade Juliana in chains before the high-society guests, attempting to crush her spirit.
promotional_strength: Features high emotional stakes, class conflict, and a strong protagonist refusing to submit under oppression.

evidence.observation: Heavy doors open to reveal the prisoner being brought in.
Juliana delivers a defiant retort to Catherine.

logline: At the height of Catherine and Rupert's lavish wedding, Juliana is paraded before high society in chains to be publicly disgraced—until a deafening explosion shatters the cathedral entrance, heralding Alexander's vengeful assault.

source_segments.label: SOUND FX
source_segments.text: Heavy wooden creak of the cathedral double doors swinging open.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide shot from behind the altar down the aisle as the great church doors slowly open, revealing the silhouette of three figures against the daylight.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Juliana, dressed in a coarse drab prison dress with a numbered identification badge, is marched forward by two armed constables holding her by the arms.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Extreme close-up of Juliana's scarred, dirtied wrists bound tight in heavy iron shackles.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Intense close-up of Juliana's bruised, dirt-streaked face. Her piercing blue eyes burn with fierce dignity despite her captive state.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of Catherine standing beside the altar, watching Juliana's entrance with gloating satisfaction.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Smug, Taunting)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: There she is.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium tracking shot of Juliana marching between the stern constables down the central aisle toward the altar.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of a seated aristocratic couple in the pews, whispering and sneering behind an ivory lace fan.

source_segments.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Gleeful, Whispering)
source_segments.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
source_segments.text: Look at her.

source_segments.label: NOBLEMAN (Mocking, Chuckling)
source_segments.speaker: NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: She actually came back to the chapel.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of the noblewoman giggling with hand over mouth, glancing spitefully at the disgraced bride.

source_segments.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Scornful, Smug)
source_segments.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
source_segments.text: Not as a bride this time.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of two senior aristocrats in the carved choir stalls, resting on their canes and nodding in smug agreement.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close profile of Juliana as she halts in the center aisle, lifting her chin proudly to face the sneering onlookers.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (O.S.) (Derisive, Projecting)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: Lady Juliana Ashcroft. Look around.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: High-angle wide shot showing Juliana flanked by guards in the center of the lavishly decorated nave, dwarfed by the grand cathedral.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (V.O.) (Mocking, Resonant)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: This is the world you thought you belonged to.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Low-angle medium shot of Catherine gesturing broadly from the altar steps, looking down upon Juliana like an empress.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Spiteful, Boastful)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: And now they can all see what you truly are.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana standing firmly between the guards, calmly meeting Catherine's venomous gaze.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Juliana looks around the cathedral at the sea of pompous faces, then raises her eyes straight back to Catherine with utter disdain.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Tight close-up on Juliana's bruised, unshaken face.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Defiant, Unbowed)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: You needed an entire chapel to feel powerful over one chained woman?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Dramatic low-angle full shot looking up at Juliana, her posture straight, imposing, and regal despite the heavy chains.
